name: agent-utilities
description: Reusable local utility skills for developer environment maintenance, layered package manager ownership, and agent tool registry workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Utility skills for local developer environments.
interface.longDescription: A personal local plugin for reusable agent utility workflows. It coordinates developer environment maintenance, explicit setup requests, runtime and tool version mismatches, direct-to-outer package manager chains such as npm over mise-managed Node, and a shared registry of agent development tools.
defaultPrompt: Use maintain-dev-env when a task is blocked or may be misled by missing tools, PATH/shim issues, package-manager ownership, project runtime requirements, or toolchain install/update/repair needs.
Use setup-dev-env to inspect my local developer environment before installing anything.
Use manage-scoop for Windows Scoop checks and updates.
Use manage-mise for directly managed runtimes and tools, outer runtime layers, and Node/npm global-prefix diagnostics.
Use maintain-dev-tool-list to update the shared developer tool registry without flattening nested manager ownership.
